snippet.title: Mosaic Of The Strange - Released 21st November!
snippet.description:
A HUGE THANKS to everyone who played Mosaic of the Strange during Steam Next Fest.

Your feedback has been amazing so I’m taking a little extra time to add polish. The new release date is 21st November 2025. A short delay, but worth it!

In the meantime - the demo’s still up if you haven’t tried it yet! https://bit.ly/MotS_Demo

Mosaic of the Strange is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring ENORMOUS interlocking puzzles. Help Special Agents Cullen and Brady investigate a bizarre murder, while discovering 125 real-world paranormal case files.

Make sure you're following me on the Divide The Plunder socials for all the latest news and info! Find my links here: https://linktr.ee/DivideThePlunder
